entities.name: Tiberius Julius Theothorses
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theothorses, also known as Thothorses, Fophors or Fofors, was the king of the Bosporan Kingdom, a Roman client state, from 279 to 309. His reign coincided with the Crisis of the Third Century and the Tetrarchy in the Roman Empire.
